claims.statement: For each accepted bounded 3D3V timestep, independently reconstructed incremental field and matter four-momentum changes reproduce the solver's separately accumulated energy and three-momentum residuals without using constant particle rest energy as an acceptance scale.
nonclaims: A closed same-step ledger does not establish a useful plasma-wing force or complete Vlasov-Maxwell fidelity.

claims.statement: The actual numerical four-residual is transformed into an oblique inertial frame and compared with a residual independently reconstructed from transformed ledger terms; cellwise electromagnetic stress-energy is separately integrated and checked against the 3D Yee field momentum, trace identity, and dominant-energy bound.
nonclaims: The bounded covariance and stress-energy checks do not prove Lorentz invariance of the full grid algorithm.
Periodic stress-energy consistency is not an open-boundary force measurement.

claims.statement: Extend the covariant ledger to a three-dimensional open kinetic control volume with electromagnetic and particle boundary transport and material force and torque.
required_evidence: external circuit, radiation, thermal, and material source terms
